latin: Ita se habet intellectus agens ad producenda intelligibilia in possibilem intellectum, sicut se habet forma artis ad producendas formas in materiam artis.
translation: The agent intellect stands to the production of intelligible objects in the possible intellect just as the form belonging to a craft stands to the production of forms in the material worked by that craft.
